bank.title: Salary bank transfer
bank.subtitle: Generates an Excel file per bank (beneficiaries + IBAN + amounts) and emails it to the bank. The sender is your company's configured email.
bank.empty: No employee paid by bank transfer for this period (check employees' payment method + IBAN).
bank.sendError: Send failed — check emails and tenant SMTP.

bankFormats.title: Bank file formats
bankFormats.subtitle: Every bank imposes its own format. Describe your bank's here: with no active profile, NexusRH sends its standard Excel template.
bankFormats.empty: No format defined — files use the standard NexusRH Excel template.
bankFormats.bankPlaceholder: Exact name as it appears on employee records
bankFormats.sampleNote: The file is not stored: only its structure (columns or positions) is read. Max {{mb}} MB.
bankFormats.draftBanner: Draft — not used for transfers until activated.
bankFormats.archivedBanner: Archived version, kept so past files can be traced to their format.
bankFormats.blankHint: Column present in the file but left empty — fill it in by hand after export.
bankFormats.unmappedWarning: {{n}} column(s) still to map — activation stays blocked until they are.
bankFormats.savedNewVersion: New draft version — the active format is unchanged.
bankFormats.activated: Format activated — the previous version is archived.
bankFormats.testFileError: Test file unavailable — check that transfers exist for this period.
